meta.title: Seasons Around the World — Set 2
meta.subject: English Reading
meta.description: Vocabulary quiz for 'Seasons Around the World' — word meanings in story context.

questions.question: What is 'snow'?
options: Soft white ice flakes that fall from the sky in winter
Warm rain that falls in spring
A sweet drink made from milk
questions.explanation: Snow consists of frozen water flakes that fall from clouds when the air is cold.

questions.question: To 'hibernate' means to fly to a warm place like Mexico.
questions.explanation: False. To 'hibernate' means to sleep or go into a deep rest through the winter to save energy.

questions.question: Which word is the imaginary line around the middle of Earth?
questions.explanation: The equator is the imaginary circle around Earth that is exactly halfway between the North and South Poles.

questions.question: 'Dark' means with little or no light.
questions.explanation: True. When it is winter at the North Pole, there is no sunlight, so it is dark all day.

questions.question: What does 'appear' mean in 'leaves appear on the trees'?
questions.explanation: To 'appear' means to become visible or come into sight. We start to see leaves growing on trees.

questions.question: In the fall, some animals _______ food so they have something to eat in winter.
questions.hint: To keep or save things for later use.
questions.explanation: To 'store' food means to gather and save it in a safe spot for winter.

questions.question: What does 'dry' mean in 'dry season'?
questions.explanation: 'Dry' means not wet, without rain. A dry season is a period with very little rainfall.

questions.question: Sort these words based on whether they describe hot/dry elements or cold/wet elements:
questions.explanation: 'Dry' and 'sunlight' go with hot/dry weather. 'Snow,' 'rain,' and 'coldest' go with cold/wet weather.

questions.question: 'Antarctica' is a warm island located right at the equator.
questions.explanation: False. Antarctica is a large icy continent at the South Pole, and it is the coldest place on Earth.

questions.question: Arrange the words to describe winter weather:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'The weather gets cold in winter.' In winter, temperatures drop.

questions.question: What does 'die' mean when plants 'die' in winter?
questions.explanation: To 'die' means to stop living. Some plants die when it gets too cold in winter.

questions.question: Sunlight is the _______ that comes from the sun and helps plants grow.
questions.hint: What you need to see, opposite of dark.
questions.explanation: Sunlight is literally the light of the sun.

questions.question: Arrange the words to show what animals do in winter:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'Some animals hibernate in winter.' This means they go to sleep all winter.

questions.question: 'Northern' refers to things or places in the north part of the world.
questions.explanation: True. 'Northern' means located in or toward the north. The Northern Hemisphere is the top half of Earth.

questions.question: What does the word 'coldest' mean?
options: More cold than one other place
The most cold out of all places
questions.explanation: 'Coldest' is the superlative form of cold. It means nothing is colder than it is. Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth.
